summary: {person} asks which days are covered when an official says midday buses are coming back.
realLife: Milwaukee’s June service notice restored weekday midday trips on four routes with county contingency money and left weekend schedules unchanged.
gates: A service restoration applies on specified days of the week.
weights: A resident with weekend shifts is less likely to benefit from a weekday restoration.
inGame: needs: release of funds, funded routes, day-of-week service and effective date.

turns.what: The office checks the first restored trip against the shift.
The office shows the Sunday timetable and records the remaining need.
turns.writesBack: Keep weekend service separate in the follow-up.
